_description: Measured human pharmacokinetics used to ANCHOR the PBPK model when a drug is present (otherwise the model falls back to first-principles estimates). Absolute CL and Vss are derived from labelled apparent values (CL/F, Vz/F) multiplied by bioavailability F. This is the slot for a company's own internal/clinical PK data — add or correct entries freely. Fields: cl_l_h (total plasma clearance), vss_l (volume of distribution), t_half_h, f_oral (absolute bioavailability), fu (plasma free fraction), fe_renal (fraction of clearance that is renal), tmax_h, source.

erlotinib.source: FDA label (Tarceva) / Lu et al., Clin Pharmacol Ther 2006 — CL/F 3.95 L/h, Vz/F 233 L, ~95% protein bound

palbociclib.source: FDA label (Ibrance) — CL/F 63.1 L/h, Vz/F 2583 L, ~85% protein bound, F 46%

methotrexate.source: FDA label / literature — predominantly renal elimination, ~50% protein bound, dose-dependent F

metformin.source: FDA label (Glucophage) — renal elimination (tubular secretion), negligible protein binding
